name: Gate 1: Cargo Test Workspace (Debug)
justification: Runs complete Rust unit and integration test suite across all workspace crates (mobi-pos, pos-core, pos-peripherals).

name: Gate 2: Cargo Test Release Profile
justification: Proves release-profile assertions hold, specifically that debug bypasses are absent and release refusal pins fire.

name: Gate 3: Cargo Clippy All Targets (Zero Warnings)
justification: Enforces strict Rust lint and hygiene standards with warnings treated as hard errors.

name: Gate 4: TypeScript Project Build Typecheck
justification: Validates full static TypeScript type correctness across tsconfig references.

name: Gate 5: Licensing & Crypto Unit Tests
justification: Executes cryptographic token verification, clock drift protection, license lifecycle, and fail-closed security tests.

name: Gate 6: Architecture & Boundary Invariants
justification: Validates trust boundaries, registry authorization, audit log write restrictions, no-fallback handling, and PIN exposure limits.

name: Gate 7: Patched Tauri Plugin SQL Wrapper Tests
justification: Explicitly invokes unit tests inside patches/tauri-plugin-sql via --manifest-path because tauri-plugin-sql is a patch dependency and not a root workspace member.

name: Ancillary Gate: Frontend Production Build
justification: IN DoD. Confirms that Vite bundling succeeds and all frontend assets and JSX components compile cleanly into dist/.

name: Ancillary Gate: Monolithic Legacy Test Suite
justification: OUT of 4.5 DoD. Aggregates 18 unrelated suites (math, cloud sync, chaos). Phase 4.5 trust scope is cleanly and completely covered by test:license and test:boundaries.

name: Ancillary Gate: Oxlint Linter
justification: OUT of 4.5 DoD. Non-blocking stylistic linter; type safety and architectural boundaries are fully enforced by tsc -b and check-boundaries.mjs.
